authority: Closest official machine-readable implementation artifact aligned to the formal 2026-04 release; not a normative OMG XMI representation.

formalRelease.authority: Formal release repository. It contains the ISO-submitted specifications and standard-library XMI, but no normative metamodel XMI/Ecore. Its README explicitly says the library XMI is Eclipse XMI and is not fully normative OMG XMI.
